nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Contributor guide defining build commands, the game/audio/state architecture split, and hard coding rules for agents.

nodes.name: mechanics.md
nodes.summary: Core game design document describing the ATB battle system, chord progressions, loop-station melody recording, party positions, and enemy variants.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm package manifest declaring dev/build/test/lint scripts and runtime dependencies including React, Tone.js and Zustand.

nodes.name: App.tsx
nodes.summary: Root App component wiring global keyboard input, session-store phase state, and overlay routing for the game.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Root component binding keyboard shortcuts and phase state to screen and overlay rendering.

nodes.name: player.ts
nodes.summary: Tone.Transport bridge that renders engine arrangement snapshots into drum, bass, melody-lane, and chord-pad voices on every 16th step.

nodes.name: sfx.ts
nodes.summary: One-shot UI and combat sound effects (victory, defeat, QTE hits, chord changes, enemy telegraphs) guarded for headless use.

nodes.name: synths.ts
nodes.summary: Allocates the pooled Tone.js voice bank once (per-instrument lead/pad/bass plus shared drums) and serves it to all audio callers.

nodes.name: ChordPicker.tsx
nodes.summary: Chord progression picker with tabbed presets and custom chords showing per-chord combat effects.

nodes.name: ChordPicker
nodes.summary: Tabbed chord preset and custom-chord picker displaying combat effects per option.

nodes.name: CustomChordBuilder.tsx
nodes.summary: Full custom chord-progression editor with per-bar Roman-numeral palette, theory scoring, audio preview, and preset saving.

nodes.name: CustomChordBuilder
nodes.summary: Edits per-bar Roman numerals with theory scoring, note preview, QTE-gated apply, and custom preset saving.

nodes.name: PartyCorner.tsx
nodes.summary: Party management panel with draggable fighter cards, front-row slots, performer selection, and bench.

nodes.name: Card
nodes.summary: Draggable fighter card showing instrument, HP, buffs, and performer state.

nodes.name: PartyCorner
nodes.summary: Manages front-row and bench slots with drag-and-drop moves and performer assignment.

nodes.name: RosterSelectModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Roster draft modal with instrument filtering and staged party selection before confirming.

nodes.name: RosterSelectModal
nodes.summary: Drafts a party from the filtered roster with staged slots before confirming selection.

nodes.name: StepGrid.tsx
nodes.summary: Main step-sequencer grid editor for melody lanes, per-bar chords, performer slots, and drum rows.

nodes.name: StepGrid
nodes.summary: Edits melody note onsets, per-bar chords, performer lanes, and drum patterns in one grid.

nodes.name: CombatScreen.tsx
nodes.summary: Combat arena layout composing foe panel, step grid, QTE panel, party cards, and combat log with a halt/retreat control.

nodes.name: CombatScreen
nodes.summary: Renders the three-column live combat stage wired to fight state, tempo, and encounter header.

nodes.name: PrepScreen.tsx
nodes.summary: Battle preparation workstation for key and tempo tuning, chord progression, melody bank, loop sequencer, and party formation.

nodes.name: PrepScreen
nodes.summary: Composes the pre-fight editor that sets fight key, tempo, chords, loop notes, and formation before engaging combat.

nodes.name: enemies.ts
nodes.summary: Static enemy profiles and instrument definitions with stats, weaknesses, and serializable timbre recipes consumed by combat and audio.

nodes.name: arrangement.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest suite covering arrangement grid edits, chord setters, and onset hashing.

nodes.name: arrangement.ts
nodes.summary: Core loop arrangement model: melody tracks, drum grids, Roman-numeral chords, and step snapshots for the audio boundary.

nodes.name: createDefaultArrangement
nodes.summary: Builds the default C-minor demo loop with seeded melodies on slot 0.

nodes.name: toggleNoteEvent
nodes.summary: Toggles a melody onset at slot, bar, and step, returning an updated arrangement.

nodes.name: clearTracks
nodes.summary: Resets all melody tracks to empty while preserving chords and drums.

nodes.name: countOnsets
nodes.summary: Counts total melody onsets across all slots for cooldown scaling.

nodes.name: toggleDrumStep
nodes.summary: Toggles a kick, snare, or hat hit at a drum grid position.

nodes.name: setBarChord
nodes.summary: Replaces the Roman-numeral chord for one bar.

nodes.name: setChords
nodes.summary: Replaces the full per-bar chord progression.

nodes.name: setBpm
nodes.summary: Clamps and sets the arrangement tempo in BPM.

nodes.name: setKey
nodes.summary: Sets the arrangement musical key.

nodes.name: snapshotStep
nodes.summary: Resolves one step to absolute MIDI melodies plus chord pitch classes for audio and combat.

nodes.name: loopLength
nodes.summary: Returns total steps per loop from bars times steps per bar.

nodes.name: locateStep
nodes.summary: Maps a global tick to bar and step coordinates within the loop.

nodes.name: hashMelodySet
nodes.summary: Hashes melody tracks plus chords for preset duplicate detection.

nodes.name: onsetKey
nodes.summary: Builds a stable string key identifying one melody onset.

nodes.name: onsetKeysOf
nodes.summary: Collects onset keys for a track grid.

nodes.name: allOnsetKeys
nodes.summary: Collects onset keys for the whole arrangement.

nodes.name: combat.ts
nodes.summary: Core ATB combat engine advancing one 16th-step tick at a time, resolving melody damage, chord effects, enemy gauges, and parry/QTE charts.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript engine with JSON-serializable state; no Tone.js, React, or DOM.

nodes.name: combatQte.test.ts
nodes.summary: Exercises chord, preset, and parry QTE flows through the combat tick loop with seeded RNG.

nodes.name: playAllOnTime
nodes.summary: Test helper that fast-forwards the combat tick loop and plays every chart note on time.

nodes.name: melodyBank.ts
nodes.summary: Pre-fight melody template bank with three factory presets plus save, delete, and lookup operations.

nodes.name: cloneTracks
nodes.summary: Deep-clones a melody track grid so templates stay immutable.

nodes.name: createDawnAnthem
nodes.summary: Factory building the Dawn Anthem starter template with strings and piano parts.

nodes.name: createStaccatoFlight
nodes.summary: Factory building the Staccato Flight starter template.

nodes.name: createSolemnGround
nodes.summary: Factory building the Solemn Ground starter template.

nodes.name: createDefaultMelodyBank
nodes.summary: Builds the default bank of three starter melody templates.

nodes.name: saveTemplate
nodes.summary: Saves a melody template, generating an id and cloning its tracks.

nodes.name: deleteTemplate
nodes.summary: Removes a melody template by id.

nodes.name: getTemplate
nodes.summary: Looks up a melody template by id.

nodes.name: parryChart.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest coverage for parry chart generation, verifying motif params and deterministic seeded chart output.

nodes.name: parryChart.ts
nodes.summary: Generative ZXCV parry chart builder producing seeded tap-and-hold motifs shaped by per-enemy pattern params.

nodes.name: qte.test.ts
nodes.summary: Covers QTE chart generation, hit and miss scoring, expiry, and parry damage math.

nodes.name: qte.ts
nodes.summary: Pure QTE chart model with tap/hold notes, melody and harmonic chart builders, press/release scoring, and parry damage scaling.
nodes.languageNotes: State is JSON-serializable; charts use step offsets with per-note timing windows.

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: Engine session singleton holding arrangement and fight state outside React with a subscribe mirror for the UI.

nodes.name: getArrangement
nodes.summary: Returns the current loop arrangement.

nodes.name: getFight
nodes.summary: Returns the current fight state.

nodes.name: getPresets
nodes.summary: Returns the melody preset store.

nodes.name: getMelodyBank
nodes.summary: Returns the melody template bank.

nodes.name: getGamePhase
nodes.summary: Returns the current game phase.

nodes.name: setGamePhase
nodes.summary: Sets the game phase and notifies subscribers.

nodes.name: toMenu
nodes.summary: Transitions the session back to the menu phase.

nodes.name: toPrep
nodes.summary: Transitions the session back to the prep phase.

nodes.name: getEncounterId
nodes.summary: Returns the current encounter definition id.

nodes.name: setEncounterId
nodes.summary: Selects an encounter if unlocked and rebuilds the fight for it.

nodes.name: getClearedEncounters
nodes.summary: Returns cleared encounter ids tracking linear progression.

nodes.name: isCurrentEncounterUnlocked
nodes.summary: Checks whether an encounter is unlocked for the current progress.

nodes.name: unlockAllEncounters
nodes.summary: Marks every encounter cleared and persists the unlock.

nodes.name: resetEncounterProgression
nodes.summary: Clears persisted progression data and resets encounter state.

nodes.name: getSelectedParty
nodes.summary: Returns the selected three-member party character ids.

nodes.name: setSelectedParty
nodes.summary: Persists the selected party and rebuilds the fight around it.

nodes.name: getCustomChordPresets
nodes.summary: Returns user-crafted custom chord presets.

nodes.name: saveCustomChordPreset
nodes.summary: Saves a custom chord progression preset and persists it.

nodes.name: mutateArrangement
nodes.summary: Applies an updater to the arrangement and notifies subscribers.

nodes.name: handleStep
nodes.summary: Advances one engine tick, records encounter clears, and notifies subscribers.

nodes.name: moveFighter
nodes.summary: Moves a fighter to a new slot within the current fight.

nodes.name: beginFight
nodes.summary: Creates a fight locked to the arrangement key and reconciles potency and cooldowns.

nodes.name: startFight
nodes.summary: Starts a fight with the given options.

nodes.name: resetFight
nodes.summary: Resets the current fight with the given options.

nodes.name: getFrontPerformerId
nodes.summary: Returns the performer id for a front-row lane index.

nodes.name: saveMelodyPreset
nodes.summary: Saves the current melody set as a named combat preset.

nodes.name: recallMelodyPreset
nodes.summary: Recalls a cooled-down melody preset and refreshes lane potency.

nodes.name: saveToMelodyBank
nodes.summary: Saves the current tracks as a named melody bank template.

nodes.name: deleteFromMelodyBank
nodes.summary: Deletes a melody bank template by id.

nodes.name: loadMelodyTemplate
nodes.summary: Loads a bank template into the arrangement and reconciles potency.

nodes.name: requestTemplateChart
nodes.summary: Requests a combat QTE chart from a melody bank template.

nodes.name: requestChordChart
nodes.summary: Requests a combat QTE chart for a chord progression.

nodes.name: requestPresetChart
nodes.summary: Requests a combat QTE chart from a saved melody preset.

nodes.name: pressChartKey
nodes.summary: Scores a QTE key press on the active chart.

nodes.name: pressParryKey
nodes.summary: Scores a parry key press on the active chart.

nodes.name: releaseParryKey
nodes.summary: Releases a held parry key on the active chart.

nodes.name: scoreQtePress
nodes.summary: Emits subscriber updates after scoring a QTE press.

nodes.name: cancelChart
nodes.summary: Cancels the active QTE chart for a given reason.

nodes.name: resetAll
nodes.summary: Resets arrangement, fight, bank, and phase to defaults.

nodes.name: subscribe
nodes.summary: Subscribes a listener to session state changes.

nodes.name: timbre.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests validating instrument timbre recipe completeness, distinct lead voices, neutral kit sanity, and beat-seat instrument resolution.

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: Guarded localStorage helpers persisting cleared encounters, selected party, custom chords, and tutorial state.

nodes.name: loadClearedEncounters
nodes.summary: Reads the cleared-encounter id list from localStorage, returning null when absent or invalid.

nodes.name: saveClearedEncounters
nodes.summary: Writes the cleared-encounter id list to localStorage as JSON.

nodes.name: loadSelectedParty
nodes.summary: Reads the selected 3-character party from localStorage, rejecting wrong-length payloads.

nodes.name: saveSelectedParty
nodes.summary: Writes the selected party id list to localStorage as JSON.

nodes.name: loadCustomChords
nodes.summary: Reads saved custom chord presets from localStorage, returning null when absent or invalid.

nodes.name: saveCustomChords
nodes.summary: Writes custom chord presets to localStorage as JSON.

nodes.name: loadTutorialSeen
nodes.summary: Reads the tutorial-seen boolean flag from localStorage.

nodes.name: saveTutorialSeen
nodes.summary: Writes the tutorial-seen boolean flag to localStorage.

nodes.name: clearAllPersistedData
nodes.summary: Removes all sound-angels keys from localStorage for a full persistence reset.

nodes.name: useSessionStore.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand mirror of the engine session wiring arrangement, combat, audio player, and WASD performance actions.
